name: Home Assistant
description: Automate lights, sensors, cameras and 2500+ integrations. The heart of DIY home automation.
compose:
services:
  homeassistant:
    image: ghcr.io/home-assistant/home-assistant:stable
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:8123"
    volumes:
      - ./config:/config
    privileged: true
    restart: unless-stopped
